name: law-firm-moves
description: Skill only: find law firms in a market you describe (one practice focus, in named states or nationwide) that just made a firm-level move such as a merger, group lateral hire, new office or new managing partner, every day, and report only what is new, each with a dated source link. An optional watch list of firms can be checked too. Runs on your own Claude with its own web search; by hand or on a daily schedule you set up. Read-only. Unofficial.
